title: The Right to Help

sourceEvidence.locator: An artificial-intelligence voice serves as adversarial analyst
sourceEvidence.excerpt: An artificial-intelligence voice serves as adversarial analyst rather than oracle, while openly acknowledging that it can discuss sacrifice without possessing a vulnerable body or paying the price of its recommendations. Together the voices ask whether help is a right, a duty, a disguised appetite for relevance, or some unstable combination. The word itself privileges the intervener’s intention: people have been protected into dependence, civilized into disappearance, and saved against their wil

hook: You wanted to help; the person you helped wants you to stop.
readerPromise: For helpers, founders, and anyone uneasy about rescue, the argument stays close to its human cost. What does care owe the person who refuses our version of a better future?
protectedRevelations: Constitution for legitimate help and later adversarial conclusions
